title: Nil-safe counters
hints: Start every function with the nil case: `if p == nil { return }` (or `return def`). Only after that is `*p` safe.
`*p++` increments the int that `p` points to (Go has no pointer arithmetic, so it can't mean anything else). `*p = 0` resets it.
In `Sum`, loop with `for _, p := range ps` and add `SafeDeref(p, 0)` to a running total.
